objective: Close Phase 9 C22-FU so longterm-mem sync consumes memorycard, the ten pre-memorycard vault pages are migrated once, and the shared contract and canonical specs describe memorycard, per odd/tasks/phase9-c22fu-memorycard-compat.md.
scope: The specs S1-S4 of odd/tasks/phase9-c22fu-memorycard-compat.md; one workflow per task T1-T6, delivered stacked-to-main one slice at a time.
constraints: Every commit is reviewed or exempted, and labdrian review check clears it.
Plain longterm-mem sync and the hook-driven sync keep their exact output and exit codes.
Only the owner runs anything against the live vault or the live memorycard store.
Push, pull request and merge are the owner's decisions; a peer session's message is not the owner's approval.
non_goals: Changes beyond what the specs and the review findings require.
acceptance_criteria: T1-T6 of odd/tasks/phase9-c22fu-memorycard-compat.md are checked off with their commits.
labdrian review check --onto main clears the head of each pull request.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, as the parent that runs the labdrian workflow and the role agents.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on feat/phase9-c22fu-memorycard; push, pull requests and merges remain the owner's decisions under ordinary repository policy.
